findings.passage: “I wanted to share how that bill was an affront to me,” Thompson told The Texas Tribune on Monday.
findings.note: Quoted by the Texas Tribune. She describes why she spoke to colleagues against SB 7, a broad 2021 voting-rules bill, ahead of the House walkout. The bill is not only about ID.

findings.passage: “We have a responsibility to pass on something,” Thompson said Monday after a meeting at the Capitol with other Black and Hispanic House members. “That’s why we’re here — to protect and preserve those rights and to pass on something for generations to come.”
findings.note: Quoted by the Texas Tribune. She speaks of protecting voting rights as a duty to pass on, in the context of the SB 7 walkout.

findings.passage: “I don't think it's a whole lot.”
findings.note: PJ Media quoting her at a July 2021 US House hearing. Asked what share of one party's voters support voter ID, she answered that she thought it was not a large share. Only the quoted words are hers; the sentence around them is the outlet's. The date is the article date (30 July 2021); the hearing was the day before, per the article's 'Thursday'.
